title: Managed rollout for a team
one_line: Generate the files an admin deploys to set up briefcase on every machine.
verified_against: Formats from the Claude Code managed-settings, Cursor hooks and Codex hooks docs (2026-11-21/22) and Apple's managed-preferences payload, pinned by golden-file tests. No generated file was installed on a managed macOS, Windows or Linux machine; the Windows .reg file and the Codex requirements.toml and Cowork steps are labelled templates.
